limitations: The registry action says 'permanently delete a separate Document as Administrator'. The built UI has no whole-Document delete. The walkthrough can delete a one-Version Document with Delete version (the dialog shows the last-version note), or delete a multi-Version Document one Version at a time. The API route DELETE /documents/:documentId still exists but no control calls it.

Negative check: a Legal Team Member sees no Delete version item in the row or Version menus and no Delete versions button in the selection bar; the API answers 403. A Business User has no Documents management controls in the Portal.

The Auto-Doc template refusal (409) is not reachable from any Documents section (DocumentsCard renders only on Contract, Matter, Entity and Knowledge Item records), so the guide omits it. document-versions.md mentions it.
The Generated redline refusal needs a Comparison export fixture; the walkthrough may skip it if the lab has none.

On an archived owning record the Document row's Actions menu is hidden, but an Administrator still sees Delete version on earlier Version rows. The guide keeps 'restore the owning record first' and does not describe this edge (see productBugs).

productBugs: dd28e33d (apps/api/src/modules/documents/routes.ts DELETE /documents/:documentId/versions/:versionId; apps/web/src/components/documents/documents-card.tsx Delete version; bulk-document-actions.tsx Delete versions) adds per-Version deletion and removes whole-Document delete from the UI. DOC-001 ('Individual versions are never edited or deleted'), DOC-010 ('Individual versions can never be deleted'; per-version delete 'breaks the negotiation record') and the DOC-010/DOC-011 UX review addendum ('explains that all versions are deleted') contradict it, and no addendum records the change. DOC-010's lawful-erasure path now takes one delete per Version, in Generated-redline-first order. Same finding as the documents group; the guides describe the built behavior.

apps/web/src/components/documents/documents-card.tsx: on an archived (frozen) owning record the Document row's Actions menu is hidden, so the current Version cannot be deleted there, but VersionActions still offers Delete version on earlier Version rows (rendered when canErase, regardless of frozen). The erasure reach on archived records is inconsistent between the two menus.
Record drift, also noted by the documents group: 229909d4 adds Partially signed as a seventh fixed Contract Document type; DOC-015 still says six.
